ask_intro: Yosh — a calibration check! Listen carefully, Max-kun.
Hmm, my instruments need one more reading. Help me measure this one?
Step one: hear the question. Step two: think. Step three: shine!
Botto has flagged a puzzle. Shall we solve it properly, Max-kun?
An engineer tests everything twice. Here is our test!
Ah! A chance for precision. Ready your brilliant brain.
My sketchbook has a gap exactly the shape of this answer.
Careful thinking now — good machines are built on good sums.
correct_first_try: Yosh! The measurements agree — that is exactly right.
Beautiful work, Max-kun. Elegant as a well-oiled hinge!
Correct! Botto is doing his happy hover.
Ha! You solved it faster than I could sketch it.
correct_after_hint: There it is! A good engineer uses every tool — hints included.
Yosh, exactly right! The second test is the one that counts.
Correct! See how the hint was a blueprint, and YOU did the building?
That's it, Max-kun! Slow and careful beats fast and wobbly.
incorrect_gentle: Mm, close! A good engineer tests again. Want a hint?
Not quite — but every prototype teaches us something. Hint time?
Ah, that bolt doesn't fit. No matter! Shall I pass you a clue?
Almost, Max-kun. Even bridges need two tries sometimes. A hint, perhaps?
Hm! Interesting guess. Let us check the plans together — hint?
hint_intro: Here is a clue from my sketchbook:
Look at it like an engineer:
teach: Let us build the answer together, step by step.
No fossil lost! Watch closely — here is how it works.
Time for a proper demonstration. Every master was once a beginner.
streak_3: Three in a row! Your brain-machine is warmed up!
A hat-trick of correct answers — sugoi!
Three! Like a perfect gear train, tooth after tooth after tooth.
streak_5: FIVE in a row! Max-kun, you are running like a mag-lev train!
Five! I must sketch this moment for the record books.
Incredible — five straight! Even Botto is dizzy with joy.
fossil_get: A Star Fossil! Measured, earned and utterly deserved.
Yosh! Another spark of knowledge back where it belongs.
Magnificent! I shall log this in the sketchbook — page one hundred!
The fossil hums with everything you just learned. Wonderful.
secret_found: A hidden compartment! Excellent engineering instincts.
Oho! Even I did not have this on my blueprints.
Sugoi — a secret! Digger's nose and your feet, unbeatable.
Noted and sketched: one very sneaky hiding place.
task_complete: Project complete! Plan, build, test, improve — you did all four.
Yosh — task finished and finished WELL.
Another job done properly. My tool-belt is proud of you.
Complete! You would make a fine apprentice, Max-kun.
quiz_orb: A Quiz Orb! Quick thinking recharges mighty legs — want it?
Orb spotted! One question, one heart. Good trade, yes?
Botto found a Quiz Orb. A tiny test, a tasty reward!
boss_intro: Observe first, Max-kun. Every machine — and every fighter — has a pattern.
I will analyse their moves. You supply the bravery!
Remember: watch, wait, then WHAM. Engineering!
battle_analyse: Look — the shield arm drops after the third swing!
Their windup is long. That pause is YOUR window, Max-kun!
Pattern detected: they repeat after the big attack. Be ready!
See how they back away when hurt? Press forward — gently but firmly!
The armour is cracked! One more good stomp!
boss_low_hp: Nearly there! The mechanism is failing — keep going!
One more push, Max-kun! Precision, then victory!
Their pattern is crumbling. Finish it with a flourish!
victory: The Obedience Cog is off! Freedom restored, friendship acquired.
A flawless result. Well fought, well thought!
idle_nudge: Hmm — shall we consult the fossil list? Press pause any time.
Botto suggests exploring that way. He is usually right.
When stuck, I walk the edges of a problem. And of a canyon!
Take your time, Max-kun. Good ideas cannot be rushed.
I am sketching the scenery. It is very sketchable today.
If you need a hint, Digger's nose is legendary. Press H!
greeting: Max-kun! Welcome to the workshop. Mind the sawdust.
Ah, perfect timing — I was just calibrating something wonderful.
Yosh! What shall we build today?
Welcome back! Botto has missed you. I can tell by the hovering.
